g.text: sp-sel is a compile-time constant with more than two valid values — the exact range

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: and which lane(s) each value names depends on the shape and precision (m16n8k16:

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: 1-of-4 lanes, sel 0–3; m16n8k32: 2-of-4). Check the PTX ISA for your CUDA version

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: rather than assuming a plain 0/1 choice.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: Net effect: hardware reads metadata, fetches only the 2 named B rows per quartet, does 2 multiplies instead of 4 → 2× throughput.
